Definition: properly, bitterness; concretely, a bitter thing; specifically bile; also venom (of a serpent)
BiblicalUsage: 1) bitter thing, gall, poison; 1a) gall, gall-bladder (seat of gall); 1b) poison, venom; 1c) bitter thing; 1d) bitterness
